newsitem.title: USA: Gallagher sees further pressure on premiums.
newsitem.headline: Gallagher sees further pressure on premiums.

text.p: J. Patrick Gallagher, president and chief executive officer of Arthur J. Gallagher & Co, said Tuesday that pressure continues on premiums across all lines, and the insurance rating environment looks to remain soft at least for the remainder of the year.

He made his comments in a statement accompanying the release of second-quarter results. The international insurance brokerage posted earnings of $0.73 per share, or $12.8 million, on revenues of $116.6 million.
Commenting on the quarter, Gallagher said new business efforts, new product development and expense controls contributed to results through June.
The second quarter was obviously helped by the company's recently announced restructuring of its pension plan and long term leased facilities in the U.K., he said.
